_comment: Root cause of the mask-vs-engine refusals that rejection_mode='filter' hides from
illegal_actions. The phase attribution lives in rejection_phase_attribution_20260919.json;
this file answers WHY, by re-evaluating the emulator's own step predicates against the state
observed immediately before each refusal (scripts/probe_shop_refusals.py) and, for the event
half, against a static parse of the two switch statements (scripts/audit_event_mask_cases.py).
Two independent probes over the same 1,500 seeds give the same 641 shop / 112 event split: the
phase census counted refusals per state, this one re-derives each one per engine predicate.
row_table is every refusal, trimmed to the fields the classification uses: [seed, floor, phase,
refused_base, gold, cost_at_that_base, offered_item_id, three potion slots]. verify_report_claims.py
re-runs the predicates on it, so the numbers in `aggregates` are recomputable, not quoted.
offered_item_id is the shop potion id for shop rows and the event id for event rows.
established: the disagreement is inside the emulator, not in this repo's action expansion: the native mask advertised the refused base in 753 of 753 refusals, and across all 176,293 decisions the flat mask never advertised a base the native mask had off (0), nor did any executed action sit outside it (0)

all 641 shop refusals are one named inconsistency: WriteActionMask's hasPotionSlot scans all three State.PotionSlots (RunEngine.cs:727) while AddPotion fills only min(2, len) of them (RunRewardGenerator.cs:1015). In every row the first two slots held a potion, the third was empty, the offered potion id was non-zero and gold >= price: a third potion slot is advertised that the engine cannot use

the 112 event refusals split into 72 failures of a precondition on an option the event does handle and 40 refusals on an option its StepEvent arm never handles at all -- the default mask arm advertises 0..EventSkipAction for every event it does not know (RunEngine.cs:3543-3548)

the two biggest event clusters are named and verified row by row: Ranwid the Elder option 0 refuses when no potion is held (RunEngine.cs:2671-2675) and 33/33 of its rows hold no potion; Stone of All Time option 0 refuses on the same condition (RunEngine.cs:2772-2776) and 25/25 of its rows hold none; the single Ranwid option-1 row has gold 53 < 100, matching RunEngine.cs:2685-2688

every event that bit is inside the statically exposed set: 13 distinct event ids appear in these 1,500 episodes ([10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 21, 23, 26, 31, 35, 40]), all of them among the 48 events whose StepEvent arm exists but whose WriteEventActionMask case does not (the mask switch handles 9 of 58 declared events)
concentrated, not diffuse: 388 of 1,500 episodes contain at least one refusal, and the 641 shop refusals sit in 326 distinct shops -- about 2.0 potion attempts each

the reading this rules out: 'the policy reaches for what it cannot afford'. Every refused shop action was affordable and every refused event option was advertised. What filter mode has been hiding is an engine capacity inconsistency plus an unconditioned event mask
not_established: whether removing the phantom third potion slot would change win rate, floor depth or deck strength -- that needs a counterfactual evaluation, and the 2026-09-02 PPO freeze bars a training run; measuring what the policy buys instead, on the same states, is the evaluation-only version of the question
the preconditions for the 11 events other than Ranwid and Stone of All Time: their arms were classified by handled-options vs precondition, not read individually
that the split generalises beyond this checkpoint and stage -- one checkpoint, act1 stage label with a mixed-act population; act2-only content is not sampled here
whether the refused potion purchase was worth more than what executed instead: rows record the executed action's base but no value comparison was computed
reproduce: ../third_party/slay-the-spire-2-emulator-main/.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/probe_shop_refusals.py --checkpoint <zip> --limit 500 --start-offset <0|500|1000> --out <file.json>; then the same venv on scripts/audit_event_mask_cases.py --out docs/evidence/event_mask_case_audit_20260919.json
scope: simulator_act1 label, mixed-act population, argmax, one checkpoint, 1,500 seeds
